description: Pause this mailbox so nothing is sent from it: campaigns and warmup wait, and a direct send is refused. Mail keeps arriving and is still read. Its settings and logins stay. Resume it with resume_mailbox. While a copy of old mail to our servers holds the mailbox's sending (get_mailbox_migration's `hold`), pausing it makes the pause yours: the mailbox stays paused when the copy ends.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: pause_mailbox
title: Pause a mailbox
